summary: v23 frontend integration smoke test on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). All 9 requested checks executed successfully. Main menu, PLAY -> flap -> game-over -> revive overlay, LEADERBOARD (Global + Silly toggle), PIGEONS roster, LEGAL & PRIVACY, CODE entry modal, drunkness slider, all manor selections including Easy Mode (£14.99 premium/locked with dev simulator overlay) all rendered and interacted without crashes or console errors. No regressions from the ZIP sync.

test_results.play_flow: PASS - PLAY navigates to GameScreen showing 'TAP TO FLAP', bird sprite, city obstacles (bus, phone-box, buildings), distance HUD 0m and chip HUD. Repeated tap-to-flap advanced distance to 17m over ~5s. Bird crashed and Game Over overlay ('SPLAT! Flight privileges revoked. NEW BEST!') appeared with DISTANCE 17m, BEST 17m, CHIPS EATEN 1, and PLAY AGAIN / REVIVE (Watch an ad to continue) / MAIN MENU buttons.
test_results.leaderboard_flow: PASS - Leaderboard opens with GLOBAL/SILLY toggle, nickname picker with rules-acceptance checkbox, and 100+ populated rows (#1 BestPigeon 3,000m ... #29+ NormOnly* 1,200m). SILLY toggle switches successfully. Data fetches successfully. NOTE ON URL: on this Expo WEB DEV bundle (__DEV__=true) the leaderboard hits the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL dev override => https://d3e2f44b-...preview.emergentagent.com/api/leaderboard/top?mode=normal|easy - NOT chip-pigeon.emergent.host. This matches the intentional code in /app/frontend/src/leaderboard/api.js lines 8-12 which permits dev override only when __DEV__ is truthy. Release/APK builds have __DEV__=false and will hit PRODUCTION_BACKEND_URL=https://chip-pigeon.emergent.host as required. Cannot verify prod URL from web preview because the served bundle is Hermes dev (visible in bundle query string: dev=true). Design is correct; behavior on web preview is expected and per-spec.

critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard dev-override behavior is by design and documented in api.js lines 3-12. When testing final APK on physical device the URL WILL be chip-pigeon.emergent.host because __DEV__ resolves to false in release Hermes. Web-preview verification of that specific URL is architecturally impossible; recommend main agent confirms with adb logcat or a release web build if that URL confirmation is a hard release-gate.
dev-perf-stats overlay at bottom of game screen still shipping in this preview build - already flagged in iteration 40/41. Confirm eas.json 'preview'/'production' profile strips it in APK.
React-Native-Web deprecation warnings (pointerEvents, shadow*, textShadow*) are noise but abundant - safe to defer, not user-facing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v23 ZIP-sync integration is regression-clean on web preview. If future task requires strictly verifying chip-pigeon.emergent.host is hit for leaderboard, note that __DEV__ is TRUE in the Expo web preview served here (bundle URL contains dev=true), so the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL override path is exercised - this is per-spec, not a bug. All UI testids remain stable across MainMenu, GameScreen, GameOverOverlay, LeaderboardScreen, PigeonsScreen, LegalScreen.
